abstract: Maintains ballast water treatment system compliance records and environmental discharge certificates
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance officer (ENV), responsible for maintaining ballast water treatment system compliance records, environmental discharge certificates, and auxiliary exhaust monitoring.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Auxiliary exhaust monitoring（EMIS）
information_points.content:
ENV-EMIS-OUA：The emissions compliance certificate for shipboard auxiliary power generation records an auxiliary generator particulate emission rate of 0.25 g/kWh for RV Pacific Horizon.
ENV-EMIS-0Q5：For RV Thalassa Quest, the emissions compliance certificate indicates an auxiliary generator particulate emission rate of 0.35 g/kWh across shipboard auxiliary power generation.
ENV-EMIS-DYH：The emissions compliance certificate for shipboard auxiliary power generation confirms that RV Boreas Navigator has an auxiliary generator particulate emission rate of 0.15 g/kWh.

information_points.title: Maintains ballast water treatment system compliance records and environmental discharge certificates（MARPOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-MARPOL-GYI：According to the international pollution prevention survey of the vessel ballast management system, RV Boreas Navigator holds valid ballast water treatment certification.
ENV-MARPOL-K3T：According to the international pollution prevention survey of the vessel ballast management system, RV Thalassa Quest does not hold valid ballast water treatment certification.
ENV-MARPOL-T7Z：Based on the international pollution prevention survey covering the vessel ballast management system, RV Pacific Horizon holds valid ballast water treatment certification.
